scripts.test:a11y: npm run build --quiet && npm run test-storybook
scripts.test:cypress:open: start-server-and-test 'npm run dev --no-open' 8000 'npm run cypress -- open'
scripts.test:cypress:component: start-server-and-test 'npm run dev --no-open' 8000 'npm run cypress -- run --browser chrome --spec "cypress/e2e/component_tests/*.feature" --env allure=true || echo "The previous command has some errors..Continuing"'
scripts.test:cypress:ember: start-server-and-test 'npm run open:ember' 4200 'npm run cypress -- run --browser chrome --spec "cypress/e2e/example_app_tests/*.feature" --env allure=true || echo "The previous command has some errors..Continuing"'
scripts.test:cypress:local: rm -rf allure-report allure-results && npm run test:cypress:component && npm run test:cypress:ember && npm run test:allure:report
scripts.test:allure:report: allure generate --single-file allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open  allure-report
scripts.test:cypress:tag: start-server-and-test 'npm run dev --no-open' 8000 'npm run open:ember' 4200 'npm run cypress -- run --env tags="@form" --browser chrome'
scripts.test:ember: start-server-and-test 'npm run open:ember' 4200 'npm run cypress -- run --env tags="@cake" --browser chrome'
scripts.open:ember: cd examples/ember-app && npm install && npm run build-muon && npm run start
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs && cd docs && npm run build
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs && cd docs && npm start
